critique: The pink-and-white particle palette, black field, and newly visible outward scatter read more convincingly as magical than prior iterations. Frame 4 now clearly expands beyond frame 1. However, the effect remains very small relative to the canvas and retains a dense, bright central clump; it reads more like a compact spark burst than the broad, airy Light and Magic-style magical bloom implied by the preset thumbnail.

suggestions.why: Increase primary particle travel so the magical bloom occupies substantially more of the frame and visibly opens over the sampled frames.
Push the secondary white spark particles farther from the core, creating the airy starry halo instead of keeping the detail concentrated in a tight puff.
Reduce the oversized soft pink primary particles so the central glow no longer obscures the individual spark structure.
